name: Read-Only Reentrancy in Multi-Asset AMM Pools

root_cause.mechanism: A pool's view function (e.g. get_virtual_price() or pool token rate) computes token pricing based on balances before internal state or LP token supply is burned. During a raw ETH/token transfer callback (e.g. remove_liquidity), the pool's nonReentrant lock only guards state-mutating functions, leaving view functions callable in an inconsistent state.

preconditions.description: The AMM pool invokes an external transfer (e.g. raw ETH or ERC777/ERC1363) allowing attacker execution during liquidity withdrawal.
The view function used by the external protocol (e.g. get_virtual_price) does not enforce a reentrancy lock.
An external protocol reads the pool view function synchronously to price collateral, calculate borrow power, or settle liquidations.

mitigations.name: View Reentrancy Guard
mitigations.mechanism: Enforce nonReentrantView or check that the pool is not locked (e.g. Balancer's getPoolTokens or Curve's lock checking) before returning prices.
